description: I work on the company's case management system, a product used by our customers, where I have taken on a large responsibility for modernizing and improving it. I single-handedly redesigned the entire user interface for both desktop and mobile, bringing it up to modern standards with a strong focus on user experience and attention to detail. I work mainly on the frontend with jQuery, but also on the backend with Visual Basic and MySQL. Alongside the redesign I have built several new features, worked with MCP integrations and delivered customer projects. I also built a calendar sync application in .NET that keeps Outlook calendars in sync via iCal and webhooks.

I maintained and developed their responsive web application using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. I continuously improved and added features to their content management system (CMS), with a focus on making it easy to use for non-technical colleagues and streamlining their daily workflows. I also built and launched their TV application for premium users on both Apple and Android platforms using React Native, and integrated Stripe to handle customer management, subscriptions and card payments.

I was responsible for a carpet warehouse and led a team of three people. My responsibilities included managing inventory and ensuring that our products were always ready for upcoming events and deliveries.
